summary.name: corpsebride
summary.one_liner: corpsebride (corpsebride.cc) is an independent fan AI tool that turns one adult face photo into a ~10-second vertical 9:16 ghost-bride or ghost-groom cemetery clip.
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes one clear adult face photo and generates a roughly 10-second 9:16 vertical clip in which cold blue mist rises from the feet in a moonlit cemetery. The user picks a Ghost bride or Ghost groom template and does not write a prompt. The page says the face and hair stay recognizable while clothing shifts into a gothic look. Pricing is pay-per-video, with a single 720p render at $8.88 (500 credits) and 480p at 375 credits. Failed renders restore credits.
notable: One photo in, ~10s 9:16 ghost bride or groom clip out, with no prompt needed
Pay-per-video credit packs with no subscription, Stripe checkout
Failed renders restore credits; render download links expire
Explicitly not affiliated with Tim Burton, Warner Bros., or the Corpse Bride film
caveats: Adults who agreed only (18+); no minors, celebrities or strangers
Render download links expire, so MP4s must be saved promptly
Output should be labeled as AI-generated when posted
